biotools.summary: Snowprint-UI is a bioinformatics tool for predicting DNA-binding sequences of transcription factors, enabling the discovery of ligand-inducible transcriptional regulators for bioengineering applications. It utilizes a protein-agnostic approach and has been shown to influence gene expression and produce dynamic ranges.
